title: Review how multi-employer bargaining affects productivity and competition
action: Make the statutory review of the 2022 bargaining changes test how multi-employer bargaining has affected wages, prices, competition and productivity, and whether single-enterprise bargaining still delivers workplace improvements.
why: Agreements covering several employers can standardise conditions across competitors, reducing firms' scope to compete by organising work differently.

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: use of multi-enterprise bargaining and its effect on wages, prices, competition, and productivity

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: degree to which it has promoted single-enterprise bargaining and achieved productivity-enhancing improvements in workplaces
